sentences.text: The Key Facts Statement must include a computation sheet of the Annual Percentage Rate (APR), and the amortisation schedule of the loan over the loan tenor.
For APR, the documents say it is the annual cost of credit to the borrower and includes interest rate and all other charges associated with the credit facility.
The bank’s KFS also shows APR as a line item in the table, with the APR stated as 8.70%.
The illustrative APR example for a UCB shows an annualized interest rate of 17.07% as the APR disclosure format.
